text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's wrong, C.B.? You look
bored outta
your mind. Didja get held
up by a teacher or
something?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that I did. She was all mad that I
jumped
down here from the window.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The breeze felt so nice passing by, I
couldn't help
but want to spread my
wings a little. I didn't think
anyone'd
notice.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, jumping out the window, that makes

sense—not! What were you thinking?!
You
could've gotten hurt! What's wrong
with stairs?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, if you wanna feel the wind in
your hair,
I've got a better option. Look
around. What do
you see?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Nothing out of the ordinary. Just
you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Just you and me! C'mon, let's
get to the
track. I'll get that tired look
off your face in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What a bold invitation. Haha,
sounds good
to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's parkour over the roof
real quick.
No sense going the long way
when the sky's so
lovely.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're on! ...Wait, no! We are NOT hopping the roof!
